Commercial Hip-Hop.feel: confident, polished, and charismatic, like a professional dancer in a music video
Commercial Hip-Hop.dynamics: alternates smooth groove-based movement with explosive accents on the strong beats

Old-School Hip-Hop.feel: playful, loose, and full of swagger
Old-School Hip-Hop.dynamics: steady, bouncy groove that stays relaxed and fun, with occasional exaggerated hits

K-Pop.feel: precise, bright, and camera-aware, with crisp synchronized-style choreography
K-Pop.dynamics: tight, exact movements that snap cleanly into poses on musical accents, with expressive facial engagement

Jazz-Funk.dynamics: contrasts slow, controlled sensual movement with sudden sharp hits

R&B Groove.dynamics: continuous, fluid groove with soft accents and minimal sharp hits

House.feel: joyful, light, and energetic, driven by the four-on-the-floor pulse
House.dynamics: constant rhythmic pulse through the torso with fast, light footwork that builds in complexity

Breaking.dynamics: standing toprock builds into floor work and ends sections on sharp freezes

Afrobeats.feel: joyful, grounded, and rhythmic, with relaxed confidence
Afrobeats.dynamics: loose, grounded rhythm with polyrhythmic hip and shoulder accents

Contemporary.dynamics: flowing, breath-driven movement with suspended moments and controlled releases

Latin / Reggaeton.dynamics: steady dembow rhythm in the hips with sharp accents and playful variation
